title: lotodes striatum
intro: Lotodes striatum, commonly known as sea fan, is a species of flowering plant in the family Haloragaceae. It is known for its potential health benefits, including being used to treat various conditions such as fever, rheumatism, and respiratory issues, due to its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties.
